items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Has Never Sold His Tesla Vision. Should You Buy the Dip Before July 22?
items.summary_cn: Musk从未放弃特斯拉愿景的叙事，分析建议在7月22日前逢低买入TSLA。

items.author: Trump
items.text: One of the biggest Driving Forces in the Future for Jobs, are Data Centers. They are big, strong, bold, and Money Machines for the State in which they are built. Governor Kathy Hochul, for political reasons, has terminated all Data Centers being built, or to be built, in New York State. These Companies are now being sought in Alabama, Florida, Texas, Arizona, and many other States. Both the Taxes and the Jobs amount to LIQUID GOLD! New York State has made a terrible decision. All of this Income, and other Benefits, will be going to Red States, and some Blue, where Data Centers are sought as Ca
items.summary_cn: Trump抨击纽约州长Hochul叫停数据中心建设，称这些公司将转向红州，利好AI/数据中心板块。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's Memphis AI empire is the epicenter of the data center backlash
items.summary_cn: Musk在孟菲斯的xAI数据中心成为全美数据中心反弹情绪的风暴眼，涉及AI算力与电力矛盾议题。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Investors Rip $565 Billion Out Of Elon Musk's Hands
items.summary_cn: SpaceX投资人从Musk手中回购/剥离5650亿美元估值的相关权益，SpaceX为非上市标的，仅作宏观叙事参考。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk secretly acquires $1B energy company to power the AI future
items.summary_cn: Musk秘密收购10亿美元能源公司以支撑AI未来电力需求，指向AI数据中心电力紧缺主题。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO Reset the Entire Space Sector. Here Are 2 Space Stocks I Would Buy the Dip On Without Hesitation.
items.summary_cn: Musk旗下SpaceX的IPO重新定价整个航天板块，分析列出两只可逢低布局的航天股，但未直接点名具体可交易标的与kcn持仓重叠。

items.author: Musk
items.text: A physicist explains the overlooked problem that could doom Elon Musk’s Mars colonization plans: dust
items.summary_cn: 物理学家指出火星尘埃问题可能威胁Musk的火星殖民计划，间接利空SpaceX叙事。
